root_cause.text: The `copy_data_into_buffer` function in the Btrfs zlib compression subsystem fails to release the reference to the folio retrieved from the page cache, resulting in a folio leak during S390 hardware acceleration.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a missing `folio_put(folio)` call inside the loop of `copy_data_into_buffer()` in `fs/btrfs/zlib.c` right after `kunmap_local(data_in)`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Release the folio reference after copying its data to prevent a reference count leak.
intent_record.what: Added a call to folio_put(folio) immediately after kunmap_local(data_in) inside the copy loop of copy_data_into_buffer.
intent_record.how: This ensures that the reference count on the folio is properly decremented after its data has been copied, preventing a folio reference leak.

grouping_result.intent: Release the folio reference after copying its data to prevent a reference count leak.

candidates.rationale: The folio reference acquired from the page cache is not released after the folio is unmapped here, causing a folio reference leak.
The loop proceeds to the next iteration without releasing the folio reference acquired in the current iteration.
